lines.t: (Verse 1)
He walked upon the winds of time,
Through the veil of the divine.
Every tear, a seed of light,
Every wound, the dawn of life.
He called the stars to sing again,
He spoke, and hearts remembered when —
Before the world began to spin,
YahuShua called our souls to Him.
(Pre-Chorus)
Every shadow melts away,
Every fear must bow and fade.
When His voice draws near the flame,
The world is healed in YahuShua’s name.
(Chorus)
Behold — YahuShua speaks!
The heavens tremble, the earth believes.
With fire and mercy intertwined,
He calls the lost, He opens eyes.
His word is thunder, His heart is flame,
He breaks the night, He heals the pain.
The Voice of YahuShua reigns —
Forever love, forever name.
(Verse 2)
He stands between the earth and sky,
The Son of Man, the crucified.
Crowned in light, in unending grace,
The Holy One, the Ancient Face.
He whispers peace where storms begin,
And breaks the walls we build within.
O Savior, pure and ever near,
Your truth resounds through every tear.
From the ashes, beauty rises,
Every soul He sanctifies.
Hearts awaken softly,
As His truth unfolds the skies.
Oh, YahuShua, breathe within,
Let Your kingdom come again.
All creation bows and cries,
The Holy One, the Lord Most High!
Behold — YahuShua speaks!
The world awakens from its sleep.
Through love and light, His truth remains,
The Lamb of God forever reigns.
His word is thunder, His heart is flame,
He breaks the night, He heals the pain.
The Voice of YahuShua reigns —
Forever love, forever name.
The voice that formed the dawn of days,
Now whispers gently — I am the Way.
The Voice of YahuShua remains…
Forever love, forever reign.
